title: Eurasia Needs 143,000 Pilots—More Than North America
hook: The biggest pilot shortage needs 143,000 new hires in Eurasia.
closing: More aircraft mean little without enough trained people to keep them moving.
question: Would you train to become a pilot?

segments.say: Airlines need 649,000 new pilots. That is a training-pipeline problem, not merely a hiring problem.
Eurasia needs 143,000 new pilots. The biggest demand is not where many viewers expect.
The jet fleet is projected to reach 48,600 aircraft. Every added plane needs trained crews.
